roomSummary: A spacious open-plan living room in the foreground connected through a wide cased opening to a bright dining room in the background, both finished with dark carpeting.
camera: The camera stands in the corner of the foreground living area, looking diagonally across the room toward the right curtained window and through the wide opening into the dining room.

landmarks.description: floor-length patterned curtains covering the large window on the right wall of the foreground room
wall outlet and switch located near the base of the partition wall between the opening and the right wall
wide cased opening connecting the foreground living space to the rear dining room
large window with grey curtains on the far back wall of the rear dining room
side window with curtains on the right wall of the rear dining room

diningSpace.reason: The dedicated room visible through the cased opening has substantial open floor space easily accommodating a 4- to 6-person dining set without hindering pathways.

layout.placement: centered on the floor of the foreground living room to define the main seating zone
positioned on the area rug in the foreground living area, facing inward toward the center of the space
centered in front of the 3-seater sofa on the area rug in the foreground living room
placed at an angle beside the coffee table on the area rug, facing toward the sofa
centered on the floor of the adjoining room visible through the wide cased opening
arranged neatly around the dining table in the adjoining room

relationships: The living room furniture forms an independent conversation zone in the foreground space without spilling into the walkway.
The dining suite is entirely contained within the adjoining rear room, visible through the cased opening.
A clear walking corridor is maintained through the cased opening between the two rooms.
avoid: Do not place dining furniture in the foreground living space.
Do not obstruct the wide cased opening between the two rooms with any seating or tables.
Do not place tall furniture against the patterned curtains on the right wall.
Do not block the light switch and outlet near the floor on the divider wall.
keepUntouched: patterned curtains and window on the right wall of the foreground room
wide cased opening frame and trim dividing the two rooms
windows and curtains in the rear adjoining room
dark wall-to-wall carpeting throughout both spaces
